conclusion: No reachable bookmaker, esportsbook, exchange or aggregator prices national, academy or third-division League of Legends. The measured external ceiling is 11 of 241 scheduled cards on a single aggregator, 8 of which are the same Worlds ties every venue prices. Every other card is originated from recorded series results and labelled model/provisional, or resolved by official settlement and left without a probability.
